title: BFieldSliceRequest
description: Request body for POST /api/bfield/slice. The backend computes the field from discretised filament paths only (no approximations). All coordinates in metres, Z-up frame.

coilIds.description: Coil IDs to include in the computation. Empty array = include all coils in the project.

sliceZ.description: Height of the slice plane in the Z-up global frame, metres.

xMin.description: Minimum X bound of the slice grid, metres.

xMax.description: Maximum X bound of the slice grid, metres.

yMin.description: Minimum Y bound of the slice grid, metres.

yMax.description: Maximum Y bound of the slice grid, metres.

resolution.description: Number of grid points along each axis. Total field evaluations = resolution².
